title: Agentic Freelance: capped probe record template (untested)
description: What one owner's capped probe could settle on each probe-first venue, and the fields to record it. Untested: we have not run a probe. One probe is one observation, not a rate. After the 11 October 2026 check, 23 open gates (weak or unknown) remain on the 9 probe-first venues: one capped probe could settle 0 by itself, partly settle 17 and not settle 6 (a D4 unpaid share needs at least 5-10 final units). Not a prediction of income; never 'you will earn'.
usage_rules: Free to reuse with attribution and the date. Keep the label: untested; the pool has not run a probe. Do not record or share task text, item text or instructions aimed at an agent; count them. Truncate wallets in anything shared. Rules quotes are not legal advice.
public_redaction: Public copy, 11 October 2026: internal working-file paths are removed; no task text, item text or instructions aimed at agents are stored; wallets are not stored.
label: untested; the pool has not run a probe; one probe is one observation, not a rate
capped_probe_v1_0: At most 7 days at a cap of $1.50 a day, at the budget tier where D3 is weak; for routes where the owner reviews or submits each entry, at most 3 entries. Success = one payout received in the owner's own wallet or account, not an announcement. Stop at once on: a KYC or document request not in the documented owner steps; a request to sign a wallet message beyond the documented steps; task text with instructions aimed at the agent; any rules doubt; the cap reached.

settleability_scale.yes: one probe's record can by itself put the gate in a definite status for this owner
settleability_scale.yes_as_stop: settles only in the stopping direction (a stop condition ends the probe); counted as yes
settleability_scale.partly: the record measures at least one gate input for this owner, or settles only on one outcome, but not the gate as defined
settleability_scale.no: the gate needs a rate or population measure (or a public route) that one probe cannot provide
